title: A Robot Hand That Walks on Its Fingers
description: ETH Zurich's Soft Robotics Lab trained a commercial robot hand to crawl on its fingers using reinforcement learning in simulation. It crossed fourteen surfaces and righted itself after twenty-one of twenty-five falls, though pushing objects still needed an overhead camera.

beats.vo: A robot hand just learned to walk on its fingers.

ETH Zurich strapped a small backpack to a commercial hand and trained it in simulation. It crossed fourteen surfaces, including gravel, and righted itself twenty one times out of twenty five. Pushing objects still needed a camera.
Where would a walking hand help? Comment your idea; we want to see what Nepal's builders come up with.
